result.summary: The page is a food delivery home screen that generally renders well. One minor styling inconsistency was found with the favorite (heart) icon backgrounds.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons on the 'Popular right now' cards have inconsistent backgrounds. The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a heart on a white/light circle, while the pizza card below shows a heart on a dark circle, creating a visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon container style (background color, opacity) across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
